title: Fail quietly for ordinary PRs at the promotion attestation gate
objective: Prevent the trusted open-docket attestation workflow from reporting false failures for ordinary pull requests while preserving exact-head binding, default-deny promotion classification, App-authenticated signing, and every existing required check.
required_evaluation: fixtures covering paginated API input, ordinary paths, the exact five-file promotion shape, malformed docket-sensitive paths, submission paths, and mixed promotion-plus-unrelated paths
workflow security checks proving ordinary PRs cannot request the App token or create the protected check
full deterministic make check, disclosure audit, and changed-path audit
fresh exact-head independent review before integration
acceptance: a successful ordinary pull-request validation produces no false failure from the open-docket attestation workflow
ordinary pull requests do not evaluate the App secret, request an App token, or create an independent-review check through this workflow
a docket-sensitive path set that is not exactly one five-file receipt-child promotion fails closed before any signing step
only the exact five-file promotion shape can request the App token and sign the exact validated head
the ruleset, required checks, App permissions, accepted promotion validator, and open-docket records remain unchanged
the change stops at a draft pull request and does not merge, deploy, publish, admit, promote, delete, or rewrite anything
limitations: This change removes false workflow failures; it does not automate substantive independent review for ordinary pull requests.
The protected independent-review requirement remains satisfied only by the installed Review Gate App after a separate exact-head review.
The attestation workflow remains intentionally specialized to reviewed open-docket receipt children.
